items.text: Carina Santa Maria is an Arlington Heights Village Trustee and the CEO of Shelter, Inc., a child welfare agency. She is a licensed clinical social worker with a master’s degree from Dominican University. She says she serves on the Cook County Child Death Review Committee.

sentences.text: Carina Santa Maria is an Arlington Heights Village Trustee and the CEO of Shelter, Inc., a child welfare agency.
She is a licensed clinical social worker with a master’s degree from Dominican University.
She says she serves on the Cook County Child Death Review Committee.

items.text: Her campaign says she wants to lower living costs, including property taxes and healthcare. She supports expanding affordable housing, including for young people leaving the child welfare system. She advocates for more mental health services and community safety. Her campaign states she backs safe staffing levels for healthcare workers and reproductive freedom. She says she increased the budget at Shelter, Inc. from $1.8 million to $6.7 million.
